data.name: Adeeb
data.gender_notes: Adeeb is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘d-b-b’, meaning to guide or advise. Adeeb is an Arabic name for boys that means intelligent, knowledgeable, wise, and learned. The name Adeeb carries the meaning “Intelligent, Knowledgeable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Adeeb usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, knowledgeable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents intelligence, knowledge, and wisdom from a spiritual perspective.
data.etymology: Adeeb belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intelligent, Knowledgeable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adeeb total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
